messages.subject: Error installing 2.13 on Windows
parts:

C:/RBuildTools/3.3/mingw_64/bin/../lib/gcc/x86_64-w64-mingw32/4.9.3/../../../../x86_64-w64-mingw32/bin/ld.exe: cannot find -lStanHeaders

(above this line everything looks  ok). I tried the devtools/github and CRAN direct download, same error.

My 2.12 compile chain works without problems.

DM
